flavorText: A growing city has many needs, and the mayor can't be expected to be everywhere at once. There must be all sorts of tasks that need to be completed for the city to run smoothly. I'll visit the town hall and take a look at the mayoral commissions board. There, I?ll find any outstanding errands I can help with. When I?m done, I'll mention it to the Town Hall Administrator to find out how else I can make myself useful around here.
mainObjectiveText: Contribute to the node by completing a mayoral commission. Check the mayoral commission board in front of the town hall.
calloutDescription: The administrator beckons you over excitedly.
name: CSQ_0152_FTUE_HelpingOutAroundTown
